connector.name: Suma Memory
connector.registryDescription: Persistent memory for Claude Code and Cursor. Stop re-explaining your project every session.
connector.summary: Hosted at sumapro.quadframe.work over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package suma-mcp-proxy. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sumanaddanki account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
